convention: A Chinese month starts on the UTC+8 civil date of the astronomical new moon. JDE is Terrestrial Time; UTC = JDE - Delta T; the civil date is the UTC+08:00 date of that instant.
historicalDecision: HKO rows before 1929 may reflect Beijing local mean time (UT+7:45:40). This dataset deliberately applies UTC+8 throughout and does not implement a historical local-time rule.

conflicts.classification: HKO lists 1914-11-17, consistent with pre-1929 Beijing local mean time (UT+7:45:40), while the new moon is 1m43s after UTC+8 midnight on 1914-11-18. This dataset deliberately applies the modern UTC+8 convention across its full range and keeps 1914-11-18; the HKO row is a documented historical-reference difference, not an open data question.
